about_the_game:
BANANA TREASURE HUNT!

Dive into a wild and unpredictable treasure hunt where bananas are the ultimate prize! In this thrilling tile-based adventure, players navigate a grid of mystery, uncovering hidden banana treasures while dodging sneaky traps and explosive surprises. Strategy, luck, and a touch of madness are your best allies in this race to become the ultimate treasure hunter. Are you ready to go bananas? 🍌💥

Banana Loco is a single player game where players try to look for banana treasures within tiles. Players can use power-ups to help them navigate the map tiles. With the use of strategy and tile memorization, Players can achieve high scores.

FEATURES

The game includes a treasure hunt within a set of tiles. Use power-ups to gain an advantage. Use them wisely because they're limited. Achieve high scores by collecting many banana treasures!

  • Tile Exploration: Players reveal tiles on the map to uncover treasures or hidden surprises.

  • Banana Treasures: Collect valuable banana treasures to win the round.

  • Explosives: Watch out for explosive tiles that can hinder your progress.

🍌✨🍌✨🍌✨🍌✨🍌✨🍌✨🍌✨🍌✨🍌✨🍌✨
